# Camila

> Camila is an AI agent for sales operations in real-estate projects, developed for the Peruvian market by BrandLift Agencia Creativa SAC.

## Company

- Legal name: BrandLift Agencia Creativa SAC
- Product: Camila
- Website: https://www.brandlift.pe/

- Purpose: Build practical AI agents that help real-estate sales teams operate with more clarity, consistency, and a human experience for every lead.

## What Camila is

Camila is an AI-native sales-operations platform for small and mid-sized real-estate companies. It is designed for teams managing multiple projects, property inventories, sales pipelines, and lead follow-up. Camila helps sales teams respond to leads, organize commercial information, and maintain a consistent process from first contact through visits and property reservations.

## Who Camila is for

- Real-estate companies and construction companies operating projects in Peru.
- Sales and marketing teams managing multiple projects or pipelines.
- Real-estate agents and advisors who need clearer lead context, follow-up, and daily commercial organization.

## Current product capabilities described on the public landing page

- Immediate, personalized attention for real-estate leads.
- Lead qualification using the company’s sales playbook and available lead information.
- Property inventory management and project-map sharing.
- Automated follow-up protocols and sales-operation workflows.
- Alerts for qualified leads, scheduled visits, conversion events, and tasks.
- Reporting and commercial visibility for sales teams, subject to the selected plan and current product availability.

## Availability and roadmap

Camila is in a pre-launch and pilot stage. Capabilities described as coming soon, roadmap, or under development are not current product guarantees. Third-party integrations should not be represented as available unless the current public product page explicitly confirms them. The Spanish website is the primary SEO and product-information source for the Peruvian market.

The public landing page includes a pre-launch pilot application for Camila Business. Applications currently close on August 31, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. Peru time. This offer is time-sensitive; consult https://www.brandlift.pe/ for the current status before describing it as available.
